title: View system metrics via “Get metrics” pop-up on the Overall System Aveva API page
summary: Use the “Get metrics” control on the Overall System Aveva API page in UPSHMI to open the metrics pop-up/page that displays all system metrics.
when_to_use: When you need to retrieve and view all system metrics from the UPSHMI Overall System Aveva API page using the “Get metrics” pop-up.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the UPSHMI Overall System Aveva API page and use the “Get metrics” control to display the system metrics pop-up/page.

access_required: UPSHMI access to the “Overall System Aveva API” page
system_preconditions: The UPSHMI page must be reachable and the “Get metrics” control must be available on the Overall System Aveva API page.

visual_references.description: Overall System Aveva API page showing the “Get metrics” control and related pop-up links (e.g., “Get errors”).

steps.title: Open the “Overall System Aveva API” page in UPSHMI
steps.purpose: Access the page that contains the “Get metrics” control used to display system metrics.
steps.instruction: In UPSHMI, open the “Overall System Aveva API” page.
steps.expected_result: The “Overall System Aveva API” page is displayed with controls including “Get metrics”.
steps.healthy_condition: The page is visible and the “Get metrics” control is present on the page.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not load or the “Get metrics” control is not available/visible.

actions.label: Open Overall System Aveva API page
actions.exact_action: Open the “Overall System Aveva API” page in UPSHMI.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot reach the page or cannot find the “Get metrics” control, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Overall System Aveva API page includes “Get metrics” which “pops up the metrics page”. OCR includes “Get metrics … Pops up the metrics page”.

steps.title: Locate the “Get metrics” control on the Overall System Aveva API page
steps.purpose: Identify the exact control that triggers the metrics pop-up/page.
steps.instruction: On the “Overall System Aveva API” page, locate the control labeled “Get metrics”.
steps.expected_result: The “Get metrics” control is located and ready to be selected.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the “Get metrics” label/control on the page.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the “Get metrics” label/control on the page.
stop_or_escalate_if: If “Get metrics” is not visible on the page, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows “Get metrics … Pops up the metrics page”.

steps.title: Select “Get metrics” to open the metrics pop-up/page
steps.purpose: Trigger the pop-up/page that displays all system metrics.
steps.instruction: Select “Get metrics” on the Overall System Aveva API page.
steps.expected_result: A metrics pop-up/page appears showing the system metrics.
steps.healthy_condition: A metrics pop-up/page opens successfully after selecting “Get metrics”.
steps.failure_condition: No metrics pop-up/page appears after selecting “Get metrics”.

actions.label: Open metrics
actions.exact_action: Select “Get metrics” to open the metrics pop-up/page.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the metrics pop-up does not appear, stop and escalate to support.
If the metrics pop-up appears but does not reflect expected system state, consider checking “Get errors” as described by the source.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “get metrics gets all the system metrics, pops it up.” OCR: “Get metrics … Pops up the metrics page”.

steps.title: Review the displayed system metrics on the pop-up/page
steps.purpose: Confirm that the metrics pop-up/page is displaying the system metrics returned by “Get metrics”.
steps.instruction: On the metrics pop-up/page, review the displayed system metrics values/fields.
steps.expected_result: The metrics pop-up/page shows all system metrics (as indicated by the “Get metrics” behavior).
steps.healthy_condition: The metrics pop-up/page is populated with system metrics data.
steps.failure_condition: The metrics pop-up/page is empty or does not reflect the expected system state.

actions.label: Review metrics
actions.exact_action: Review the displayed system metrics on the pop-up/page.

stop_or_escalate_if: If metrics appear but do not reflect expected system state, consider checking “Get errors” as described by the source.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “get metrics gets all the system metrics, pops it up.” OCR also notes “Get errors … Pops up the current errors”.

success_criteria: Selecting “Get metrics” opens the metrics pop-up/page.
The metrics pop-up/page displays system metrics (i.e., “Get metrics gets all the system metrics”).
healthy_conditions: Metrics pop-up/page is visible and populated after selecting “Get metrics”.
failure_conditions: Metrics pop-up/page does not appear after selecting “Get metrics”.
Metrics pop-up/page appears but does not reflect expected system state.
escalation_guidance: If the metrics pop-up does not appear, stop and escalate to support.
If metrics appear but do not reflect expected system state, check “Get errors” (also a pop-up on the Overall System Aveva API page) as the next diagnostic step.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Overall System Aveva API page controls including “Get metrics” (and “Get errors” as a related pop-up).

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “get metrics gets all the system metrics, pops it up.” OCR: “Get metrics … Pops up the metrics page”; also “Get errors … Pops up the current errors”.

image_refs.what_to_look_at: Overall System Aveva API page controls including “Get metrics” (and “Get errors” as a related pop-up).

missing_details: The packet does not provide the specific names/labels of the individual system metric fields shown on the metrics pop-up/page.
